name: Continual Flame

header.Components: V, S, M (ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.material: ruby dust worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes

authored_intent: Consumed 50-GP ruby dust; exact touched object emits torch-equivalent light; no heat/oxygen consumption; can be covered/hidden but not ordinary smothered; until dispelled.

rules.text: A flame springs from an object that you touch.
The effect casts Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
It looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and consumes no fuel.
The flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.
